Opening speech by Minister Josephine Teo at the second reading of the ELIONA Bill

15 October 2024

Mr Speaker, Sir.

Mr Speaker, Sir, I beg to move, “That the Bill be now read a second time”. The Elections (Integrity of Online Advertising) (Amendment) Bill, or ELIONA Bill, seeks to amend the Parliamentary Elections Act and the Presidential Elections Act to prohibit the publication of online election advertising that contains realistic but fake content of candidates.

Digitally generated or manipulated content can mislead voters about what a candidate said or did. The Bill therefore sets out a narrow prohibition during the election period, and it provides for corrective directions and offences.

Scope of the prohibition

The prohibition applies to content that is realistic and depicts a candidate saying or doing something that the candidate did not say or do.
